dct_description_sm: The objectives of this project were: -To identify potential landscape hazards in Mayo and Pelly Crossing (Yukon);  -To develop surficial geology maps of the communities depicting surface and sub-surface material distributions, as well as permafrost distribution and characteristics; -To develop community-specific climate change projections and -To summarize the knowledge of existing surface materials of the region to predict the likely responses of the landscape to future climate changes.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Landscape Hazards in Yukon Communities: Geological Mapping for Climate Change Adaptation Planning
